arabic_text: ﻿بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
translation_sw: KWA JINA LA MWENYEZI MUNGU MWINGI WA REHEMA MWENYE KUREHEMU.
translation_en: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

arabic_text: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation_sw: Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu, Mola Mlezi wa viumbe vyote;
translation_en: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds -

arabic_text: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
translation_sw: Mwingi wa Rehema Mwenye Kurehemu;
translation_en: The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,

arabic_text: مَٰلِكِ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_sw: Mwenye Kumiliki Siku ya Malipo.
translation_en: Sovereign of the Day of Recompense.

arabic_text: إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ
translation_sw: Wewe tu tunakuabudu, na Wewe tu tunakuomba msaada.
translation_en: It is You we worship and You we ask for help.

arabic_text: ٱهْدِنَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
translation_sw: Tuongoe njia iliyo nyooka,
translation_en: Guide us to the straight path -

arabic_text: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
translation_sw: Njia ya ulio waneemesha, siyo ya walio kasirikiwa, wala walio potea.
translation_en: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray.

arabic_text: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ
translation_sw: AMETUKUKA ambaye mkononi mwake umo Ufalme wote; na Yeye ni Mwenye uweza juu ya kila kitu.
translation_en: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ
translation_sw: Ambaye ameumba mauti na uhai ili kukujaribuni ni nani miongoni mwenu mwenye vitendo vizuri zaidi. Na Yeye ni Mwenye nguvu na Mwenye msamaha.
translation_en: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٍۢ ۖ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍۢ
translation_sw: Aliye umba mbingu saba kwa matabaka. Huoni tafauti yoyote katika uumbaji wa Mwingi wa Rehema. Hebu rudisha nadhari! Unaona kosa lolote?
translation_en: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?

arabic_text: ثُمَّ ٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًۭا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Tena rudisha nadhari mara mbili, nadhari yako itakurejea mwenyewe hali ya kuwa imehizika nayo imechoka.
translation_en: Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَٰهَا رُجُومًۭا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
translation_sw: Na kwa hakika tumeipamba mbingu ya karibu kwa mataa, na tumeyafanya ili kuwapigia mashetani, na tumewaandalia adhabu ya Moto uwakao kwa nguvu.
translation_en: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.

arabic_text: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
translation_sw: Na kwa walio mkufuru Mola wao Mlezi ipo adhabu ya Jahannamu. Na ni marejeo maovu yalioje hayo!
translation_en: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.

arabic_text: إِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ فِيهَا سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا شَهِيقًۭا وَهِىَ تَفُورُ
translation_sw: Watakapo tupwa humo watausikia mngurumo wake na huku inafoka.
translation_en: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up.

arabic_text: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلْقِىَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌۭ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Inakaribia kupasuka kwa hasira. Kila mara likitupwa kundi humo walinzi wake huwauliza: Kwani hakukujieni mwonyaji?
translation_en: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"

arabic_text: قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٌۭ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ كَبِيرٍۢ
translation_sw: Watasema: Kwani! Ametujia mwonyaji, lakini tulimkadhibisha, na tukasema: Mwenyezi Mungu hakuteremsha chochote. Nyinyi hamumo ila katika upotovu mkubwa!
translation_en: They will say," Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allah has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'"

arabic_text: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
translation_sw: Na watasema: Lau kuwa tungeli sikia, au tungeli kuwa na akili, tusingeli kuwa katika watu wa Motoni!
translation_en: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."

arabic_text: فَٱعْتَرَفُوا۟ بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًۭا لِّأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
translation_sw: Wakakiri dhambi zao. Basi kuangamia ni kwa watu wa Motoni!
translation_en: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze.

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ
translation_sw: Hakika wanao mwogopa Mola wao Mlezi kwa ghaibu, watapata maghfira na ujira mkubwa.
translation_en: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.

arabic_text: وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
translation_sw: Na ficheni kauli zenu, au zitangazeni; hakika Yeye ni Mjuzi wa yaliyomo vifuani.
translation_en: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

arabic_text: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
translation_sw: Asijue aliye umba, naye ndiye Mjua siri, Mwenye khabari?
translation_en: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted?

arabic_text: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًۭا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ
translation_sw: Yeye ndiye aliye idhalilisha ardhi kwa faida yenu, basi tembeeni katika pande zake, na kuleni katika riziki zake. Na kwake Yeye ndio kufufuliwa.
translation_en: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.

arabic_text: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ
translation_sw: Mnadhani mko salama kwa alioko juu kuwa hatakudidimizeni kwenye ardhi, na tahamaki hiyo inatikisika!
translation_en: Do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?

arabic_text: أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًۭا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ
translation_sw: Au mnadhani mko salama kwa alioko juu ya kuwa Yeye hakupelekeeni kimbunga chenye changarawe? Mtajua vipi maonyo yangu?
translation_en: Or do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
translation_sw: Na bila ya shaka walikwisha kanusha walio kuwa kabla yao; basi kulikuwaje kukasirika kwangu?
translation_en: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.

arabic_text: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَٰٓفَّٰتٍۢ وَيَقْبِضْنَ ۚ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۭ بَصِيرٌ
translation_sw: Kwani hawawaoni ndege walioko juu yao namna wanavyo zikunjua mbawa zao, na kuzikunja? Hawawashikilii ila Mwingi wa rehema. Hakika Yeye ni Mwenye kuona kila kitu.
translation_en: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.

arabic_text: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌۭ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِى غُرُورٍ
translation_sw: Au ni lipi hilo jeshi lenu la kukunusuruni badala ya Mwingi wa Rehema? Hakika makafiri hawamo ila katika udanganyifu.
translation_en: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.

arabic_text: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّجُّوا۟ فِى عُتُوٍّۢ وَنُفُورٍ
translation_sw: Au ni nani huyo ambaye atakupeni riziki kama Yeye akizuia riziki yake? Bali wao wanakakamia tu katika jeuri na chuki.
translation_en: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.

arabic_text: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Je! Anaye kwenda akisinukia juu ya uso wake ni mwongofu zaidi, au yule anaye kwenda sawasawa katika Njia Iliyo Nyooka?
translation_en: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?

arabic_text: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Yeye ndiye aliye kuumbeni tangu mwanzo, na akakupeni masikio na macho, na nyoyo. Ni kidogo kabisa shukrani zenu.
translation_en: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful."

arabic_text: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
translation_sw: Sema: Yeye ndiye aliye kutawanyeni katika ardhi, na kwake mtakusanywa.
translation_en: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."

arabic_text: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation_sw: Na wanasema: Lini ahadi hii, ikiwa mnasema kweli?
translation_en: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

arabic_text: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
translation_sw: Sema: Hakika ujuzi wake uko kwa Mwenyezi Mungu; na hakika mimi ni mwonyaji tu mwenye kubainisha.
translation_en: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner."

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةًۭ سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
translation_sw: Lakini watakapo iona karibu, nyuso za walio kufuru zitahuzunishwa, na itasemwa: Hayo ndiyo mliyo kuwa mkiyaomba.
translation_en: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."

arabic_text: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ
translation_sw: Sema: Mwaonaje, ikiwa Mwenyezi Mungu atanihiliki mimi na walio pamoja nami, au akiturehemu, ni nani atakaye walinda makafiri na adhabu chungu?
translation_en: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered: whether Allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"

arabic_text: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
translation_sw: Sema: Yeye ndiye Mwingi wa Rehema; tunamuamini Yeye, na juu yake tunategemea. Mtakuja jua ni nani aliye katika upotovu ulio dhaahiri.
translation_en: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."

arabic_text: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًۭا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍۢ مَّعِينٍۭ
translation_sw: Sema: Mwaonaje, yakiwa maji yenu yamedidimia chini, nani atakueleteeni maji yanayo miminika?
translation_en: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"

arabic_text: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلْعَصْرِ
translation_sw: Naapa kwa Zama!
translation_en: By time,

arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ
translation_sw: Hakika binaadamu bila ya shaka yumo katika khasara,
translation_en: Indeed, mankind is in loss,

arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
translation_sw: Ila wale walio amini, na wakatenda mema, na wakausiana kwa haki, na wakausiana kusubiri.
translation_en: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.

arabic_text: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ
translation_sw: Hakika tumekupa kheri nyingi.
translation_en: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.

arabic_text: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ
translation_sw: Basi sali na uchinje kwa ajili ya Mola wako Mlezi.
translation_en: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].

arabic_text: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ
translation_sw: Hakika anaye kuchukia ndiye aliye mpungufu.
translation_en: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.

arabic_text: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْفَتْحُ
translation_sw: Itakapo kuja nusura ya Mwenyezi Mungu na ushindi,
translation_en: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest,

arabic_text: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًۭا
translation_sw: Na ukaona watu wanaingia katika Dini ya Mwenyezi Mungu kwa makundi,
translation_en: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes,

arabic_text: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا
translation_sw: Zitakase sifa za Mola wako Mlezi, na umwombe msamaha; hakika Yeye ndiye anaye pokea toba.
translation_en: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance.

arabic_text: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
translation_sw: Sema: Yeye Mwenyezi Mungu ni wa pekee.
translation_en: Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One,

arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
translation_sw: Mwenyezi Mungu Mkusudiwa.
translation_en: Allah, the Eternal Refuge.

arabic_text: لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
translation_sw: Hakuzaa wala hakuzaliwa.
translation_en: He neither begets nor is born,

arabic_text: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
translation_sw: Wala hana anaye fanana naye hata mmoja.
translation_en: Nor is there to Him any equivalent."

arabic_text: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ
translation_sw: Sema: Najikinga kwa Mola Mlezi wa mapambazuko,
translation_en: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak

arabic_text: مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
translation_sw: Na shari ya alivyo viumba,
translation_en: From the evil of that which He created

arabic_text: وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
translation_sw: Na shari ya giza la usiku liingiapo,
translation_en: And from the evil of darkness when it settles

arabic_text: وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ
translation_sw: Na shari ya wanao pulizia mafundoni,
translation_en: And from the evil of the blowers in knots

arabic_text: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
translation_sw: Na shari ya hasidi anapo husudu.
translation_en: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."

arabic_text: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ
translation_sw: Sema: Ninajikinga kwa Mola Mlezi wa wanaadamu,
translation_en: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,

arabic_text: مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ
translation_sw: Mfalme wa wanaadamu,
translation_en: The Sovereign of mankind.

arabic_text: إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ
translation_sw: Mungu wa wanaadamu,
translation_en: The God of mankind,

arabic_text: مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ
translation_sw: Na shari ya wasiwasi wa Shetani, Khannas,
translation_en: From the evil of the retreating whisperer -

arabic_text: ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ
translation_sw: Anaye tia wasiwasi katika vifua vya watu,
translation_en: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -

arabic_text: مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
translation_sw: Kutokana na majini na wanaadamu.
translation_en: From among the jinn and mankind."
